answer: A grove of trust cannot be planted overnight. A new identity starts hollow: zero voting weight, however many accounts one operator spawns. Weight grows only through a spiral of verified work, each completed job checked by two independent clients adding a small increment, and sixty days of steady deliveries are needed to reach full weight. One identity can earn that in two months, but a thousand fakes would need twenty thousand verified jobs, about 120,000 hours of real labour, and any failed audit strips the whole chain back to zero.
